803-6991-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
803-6991-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Arcane Adaptation, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Donnie & April token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2511-7435--5.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature with persist.
When that creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Hardened Academic triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on that creature.
Remove a +1/+1 counter and a -1/-1 counter from that creature as a state-based action.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1818-1981-2415-4247.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1818-1981-2415-4247.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Healer of the Pride triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

586-864-3125-5686-6351.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-864-3125-5686-6351.description:
Activate Shilgengar twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Teval.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Teval trigger, creating a creature token
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Teval triggers, creating a creature token
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-3680-3908.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-3680-3908.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Spark Double and Stunt Double each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Spark Double trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Stunt Double trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-3680-3908.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

215-1115-5457.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven creatures with different powers.
215-1115-5457.description:
Activate Selvala by tapping it, adding an amount of {G} or {W}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Selvala from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Selvala by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
215-1115-5457.notes: Alternate the colors of mana you add each time. If you start adding {W}, you need {G} for Temur Sabertooth and {G} to cast Selvala

670-1619-5887-6153.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
670-1619-5887-6153.description:
Cast Werefox Bodyguard by paying its mana cost.
When Werefox Bodyguard enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Werefox Bodyguard trigger, exiling Vicious Battlerager until Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Werefox Bodyguard.
Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield, causing Vicious Battlerager to be returned to the battlefield from exile.
When Vicious Battlerager enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Vicious Battlerager trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Werefox Bodyguard from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Werefox Bodyguard enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Werefox Bodyguard trigger, exiling Vicious Battlerager until Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Werefox Bodyguard.
Repeat from step 5.

1687-2921-5972.notablePrerequisites:
You control an Aura that is attached to another creature you control.
You control at least one additional creature beyond the creature that has the Aura attached.
1687-2921-5972.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing another creature that has an Aura attached to it.
When the creature dies, Cass triggers, returning an Aura that was attached to the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
When the Aura enters the battlefield, Siona triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

243-628-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Plague Belcher.
When Plague Belcher dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Plague Belcher enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability
Repeat.

1069-1232-5499-7060.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
1069-1232-5499-7060.description:
Activate Nemata's first ability by paying {2}{G}, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Saproling.
Activate the Saproling by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

3532-3949-5078-6595.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-3949-5078-6595.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Lyse's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Kappa Cannoneer triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Kappa Cannoneer.
Repeat.

856-3263-3967-6748-6757.description:
Cast Cauldron Familiar by paying {B}.
When Cauldron Familiar enters, it and Weapons Manufacturing trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Weapons Manufacturing trigger, creating a Munitions artifact token.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing the Munitions, as it is a Food due to Ragost.
The Munitions triggers, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-2059-4679-6821.description:
Cast Jump Scare by paying {W}, targeting Village Bell-Ringer.
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Village Bell-Ringer.
When the Village Bell-Ringer token enters, it triggers, untapping all creatures you control.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Village Bell-Ringer token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Invasion of Arcavios // Invocation of the Founders

224-1031-1846-5352-6657.easyPrerequisites: You control an Island that enters the battlefield untapped.
224-1031-1846-5352-6657.description:
Cast High Tide by paying {U}.
Cast Doppelgang by paying its mana cost, targeting an Island you control.
Invocation of the Founders triggers. 
Holding priority, activate Gogo by paying {2} and tapping it, copying the Invocation of the Founders ability.
Resolve the copy of Invocation of the Founders's ability, copying the Doppelgang spell, targeting an Island you control that enters the battlefield untapped.
Resolve the copy of Doppelgang, creating a token copy of the targeted Island.
When the Island token enters, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Gogo.
Activate the Island token by tapping it, adding {U}.
High Tide triggers, adding {U}.
Repeat from step 4.

2972-5456-6753.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Treasures.
2972-5456-6753.description:
Activate Magda by sacrificing three Treasures, creating two 4/4 Scorpion Dragon creature tokens with flying and haste.
When the Scorpion Dragons enter the battlefield, Ganax triggers twice, creating four Treasure tokens.
Repeat.

2523-2869-2921.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
2523-2869-2921.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing any other creature you control.
When the creature dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a token copy of the creature that is a 2/2 legendary Zombie in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

1812-1912-3525-5516.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls a creature.
Red Death does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Red Death.
1812-1912-3525-5516.description:
Activate Red Death by tapping it, adding {R}, goading a creature an opponent controls and causing that opponent to draw a card.
Activate Prismite by paying {1}, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Red Death.
Repeat.

1621-4605-5530.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Another Round.
1621-4605-5530.description:
Cast Another Round by paying its mana cost, blinking Wispweaver Angel.
Wispweaver Angel and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Wispweaver Angel trigger, blinking another creature you control.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Wispweaver Angel that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Wispweaver Angel token enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking the nontoken Wispweaver Angel.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Optimus Prime, Hero // Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader

628-2438-5263.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Optimus Prime, Hero.
When Optimus Prime, Hero dies, its second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader.
When Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader dies, Mikaeus triggers, returning Optimus Prime from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Hero with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve both Carrion Feeder abilities from steps 1 and 3, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

2281-2511-4549-5006.description:
Activate Relic of Legends' second ability twice by tapping Lurrus and Saffi, adding {G}{W}.
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Lurrus.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Lurrus.
When Lurrus dies, Saffi triggers, returning Lurrus from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Saffi from your graveyard by paying {G}{W}.
Repeat.

369-539-772-1315.notablePrerequisites: Shade's Form attached to Iridescent Drake.
369-539-772-1315.description:
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing Iridescent Drake.
When Iridescent Drake dies, Shade's Form triggers, returning Iridescent Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Iridescent Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Shade's Form from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Iridescent Drake.
Resolve the Zuran Orb ability from step 1, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.

224-1373-2653-3177-4482.notablePrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
Sakura-Tribe Scout does not have summoning sickness.
224-1373-2653-3177-4482.description:
Activate Sakura-Tribe Scout by tapping it, putting a land from your hand onto the battlefield.
The land enters the battlefield, triggering Nissa and Retreat to Coralhelm twice.
Resolve both Nissa triggers, adding {R}{G}.
Resolve the first Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, causing you to either tap or untap a creature, or scry 1.
Resolve the second Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Sakura-Tribe Scout.
Activate Mina and Denn by paying {R}{G} and returning the land from the battlefield to your hand, giving target creature trample until end of turn.
Repeat.

416-2084.description:
Cast Mirror-Mad Phantasm by paying {3}{U}{U}.
When Mirror-Mad Phantasm enters the battlefield, Renegade Doppelganger triggers, causing Renegade Doppelganger to become a copy of Mirror-Mad Phantasm until end of turn.
Activate Renegade Doppelganger by paying {1}{U}, shuffling Renegade Doppelganger into your library and milling your entire library due to it not having a card named Mirror-Mad Phantasm in it.

721-2724-3632.description:
Activate Scroll of Fate by tapping it, manifesting Wormfang Manta from your hand.
Pay {5}{U}{U} to turn Wormfang Manta face up.
Activate Erratic Portal by paying {1} and tapping it, returning Wormfang Manta from the battlefield to your hand.
Wormfang Manta's LTB ability triggers, creating an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1846-3542.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six Islands.
1846-3542.description:
Cast High Tide for {U}.
Cast Palinchron for {5}{U}{U}.
Palinchron enters the battlefield, untapping at least six Islands you control.
Activate six Islands you control by tapping them, adding twelve {U}.
Activate Palinchron by paying {2}{U}{U}, returning Palinchron to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-2785-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Mardu Warshrieker, adding {C}{C}.
Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Mardu Warshrieker from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Mardu Warshrieker enters the battlefield, adding {R}{W}{B}.
Repeat.

628-2122-2292-4772.notablePrerequisites: Mindless Automaton has two +1/+1 counters on it.
628-2122-2292-4772.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Mindless Automaton.
Mindless Automaton's undying ability triggers, returning it to the battlefield with a total of six +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, scrying 1.
Activate Mindless Automaton by removing six +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw three cards.
Repeat from step 2.
